title: Claude / ChatGPT / Udio - Did this for me (Cubetrix Web Game)
author: aluode

comments.author: Tyrannicus100BC
comments.body: Really, really cool! What was the process like? IE, was it a one shot? How much iteration did you need to do? You mentioned both Claude and ChatGPT, how did you use those together?

replies.author: aluode
replies.body:
The idea was actually initially about month ago for a python game based on a different sort of procedural field. It was initially few prompts. Ie adding voice, funny bits and some trouble shooting. That was in python. Yesterday i realized it could be done as webgame that was like 2 3 prompts. Then perhaps 10 to trouble shoot things. Claude was messing up turning with mouse while chatgpt could do that - but claude wrote the initial conversion. 

I use claude and chatgpt all the time together. If one cant do something I ask the other. In this case 3.7 claude and o3 hight chatgpt. 

Perhaps the magic initially was to know to ask claude to do a python game using ursina library ' which it was then able to turn into web based game somehow.. Now all it needs is polishing - levels and story - which i may not be up to doing. But I realize the fact they could do this points to a world where you can ask for very complicated web based games if you just have a idea.
